source.value: Rippers Unmasked — STELLA IMPULSUM (Calamity) — learned via the Calamity Heroic Skill (must have mastered Malefactor)

summary.value: You assault the target's body with a sensory onslaught.

system.description: You assault the target's body with a sensory onslaught. All stimuli, from pleasure to pain, light up at the same time. The target suffers dazed, enraged, poisoned, shaken, slow, and weak.
